After Qh8+ Kxh8, White is still up a rook and has more threats. The best move is clearly **Qxa8+**, winning a full rook by force and leading to either a material advantage or quick mate. All of Black's defenses fail.

**Best move:** Qxa8+

**Main line:** Qxa8+ Qc8 Qxc8+ (or Kh7 Qh8+ Kxh8 and White is up a rook with overwhelming advantage)

**Motif:** hangingPiece

**Explanation:**
Your queen was attacked, so you might have panicked—but Black's rook on a8 was hanging (undefended). Capture it with check! After Black blocks with the queen, your queen recaptures with check again, and Black has no defense. Even if Black runs with Kh7, Qh8 is mate. The lesson: when attacked, look for forcing moves that counter-attack. An undefended piece is always a clue to calculate tactics.
